['Zeppelin GmbH '].company_description: Zeppelin GmbH operates in plant engineering for the handling of bulk materials, serving industries such as plastic, rubber, tire, chemicals, and food. They provide services including basic engineering, in-house production of components, and control.

['Franz Haniel & Cie. GmbH '].company_description: Franz Haniel & Cie. GmbH is a German family-owned investment holding company headquartered in Duisburg, Germany. It was founded in 1756 and is one of Europe's largest privately owned family businesses. The company operates as an investment holding company and is considered one of the wealthiest families in Germany.
